entities.summary: Oskar Gustav Jæger was a Norwegian economist and politician. He obtained the cand.jur. degree in 1897 and was appointed research fellow in national economics in 1898. He was Professor of Economics (1902–1930) at the Faculty of Law of The Royal Frederick University, and served as Dean of the Faculty of Law 1909–1911.
